definitions.meaning: That is above the air (lyft) (applied to the second heaven)

quotations.old_english: Siofon heofonas sindon in gewritum leornode, þ-bar; is, se lyftlica heofon and se oferlyftlica . . . sió durn ðæs oferlyftlican heofones is nemned Elioth

source_text: ofer-lyftlic; adj. That is above the air (lyft) (applied to the second heaven) :-- Siofon heofonas sindon in gewritum leornode, þ-bar; is, se lyftlica heofon and se oferlyftlica . . . sió durn ðæs oferlyftlican heofones is nemned Elioth, Nap. 50.
